s: Video HW: frame dekat playhead tetap ImageBitmap, frame jauh dikompresi sebagai keyframe video WebCodecs dengan preferensi hardware. RAM dan CPU biasanya jauh lebih hemat daripada PNG; kualitas preview sangat tinggi tetapi tidak pixel-identical. Ekspor tetap asli. ⚠️ Kompatibilitas bergantung pada browser, SoC, dan driver codec. prefer-hardware hanya preferensi dan tidak menjamin encoder hardware digunakan; jika encoder/decoder tidak didukung atau gagal, Open Motion otomatis fallback ke Cache Klasik.
en: Video HW: frames near the playhead stay ImageBitmap, distant frames are compressed as WebCodecs video keyframes with a hardware preference. RAM and CPU use are usually far lower than PNG; preview quality is very high but not pixel-identical. Export stays native. ⚠️ Compatibility depends on the browser, the SoC and the codec driver. prefer-hardware is only a preference and does not guarantee that a hardware encoder is used; if the encoder/decoder is unsupported or fails, EditorsHub falls back to the Classic Cache automatically.

s:
Diagnostik freeze preview V5.281

Timeline maju tetapi video tertahan? Uji bagian bermasalah 20–30 detik, lalu hentikan dan unduh laporan. Tidak perlu render/ekspor.

Sampling sumber maksimal 4×/detik, riwayat 1×/detik. Menggunakan callback frame yang sudah ada; tidak mengubah FPS, kualitas, pre-render, ambient atau sinkronisasi.
en:
Preview freeze diagnostics V5.281

Timeline advances but the video is stuck? Test the problem section for 20–30 seconds, then stop and download the report. No render/export needed.

Source sampling at most 4×/second, history 1×/second. Uses the frame callback that already exists; it does not change FPS, quality, pre-render, ambient or sync.

s: Auto mengikuti waktu layer. Matikan Auto untuk keyframe Progress. Maksimal 120 pecahan deterministik; kamera efek lokal, bukan kamera komposisi. Pecahan di luar margin raster/kanvas terpotong. Margin besar menambah memori. Perubahan Pieces/Seed/Impact membangun ulang mesh. Shatter memakai permukaan terdekat (bukan kaca refraksi).
en: Auto follows the layer time. Turn Auto off to keyframe Progress. At most 120 deterministic shards; the camera is a local effect camera, not the composition camera. Shards outside the raster/canvas margin are clipped. A larger margin uses more memory. Changing Pieces/Seed/Impact rebuilds the mesh. Shatter uses the nearest surface (not refractive glass).

s: Tanda + mengikuti observasi 2D asli, tanpa lingkaran 3D. Titik yang dipilih berwarna kuning dan lebih besar; warna lain menunjukkan kualitas/estimasi yang dijelaskan pada legenda filter. Saat Play, posisi di antara sampel diinterpolasi hanya pada lintasan yang tersambung. Titik hilang tidak disambung atau diberi kedalaman palsu.
en: + marks follow the original 2D observations, without 3D circles. The selected point is yellow and larger; other colours show the quality/estimate explained in the filter legend. During playback, positions between samples are interpolated only along connected tracks. Missing points are not joined or given a fake depth.
